content.short: Birdeye.so is an on-chain trading data aggregator that helps traders make better trading decisions.
content.description: Birdeye.so is an on-chain crypto trading data aggregator that aims to give fair access to investment opportunities for all traders. It connects with 200+ DEXes and AMMs across Solana, Sui, Ethereum, and other EVM-compatible chains, delivering accurate token data and comprehensive trading insights. Whether you're researching tokens, tracking price movements, or comparing liquidity across networks, Birdeye provides the data you need to make informed decisions.
